observation.visible_scene: An open cardboard box sits on a patch of bare dirt bordered by grass and scattered dry leaves. Inside the box a fire burns on a bed of twigs/sticks and leaf litter. Bright yellow-orange flames with reddish tips rise from the box, and a faint wisp of pale smoke appears at the left flap edge.
visible_changes: The flames continuously flicker, expand, contract, and change shape from frame to frame; there is no single stable flame silhouette.
The flame column repeatedly tilts/leans toward the upper-right of the frame, with detached tongue-like tips breaking off above the box.
Flame height varies: bushier, lower spread in the early frames versus taller, narrower rising plumes in later frames (e.g., the long rightward-leaning column near the end).
The bright incandescent core at the base of the fire persists throughout, with the glowing fuel bed visible inside the box.
The box, its open flaps, the ground, and the grass remain fixed in the frame; the only motion is the fire itself.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the fire was ignited and what specific fuel is burning.
Whether the fire grows, dies, or continues after the last frame.
The cause of the rightward flame lean (e.g., wind) is not directly visible.
uncertain_details: Camera appears static (background and box position unchanged), but minor handheld jitter cannot be ruled out.
The apparent smoke on the left is faint and could be heat haze or actual smoke.
